Her answer, at 14:05, changes what we know about this account: 'And if ur talking about content in messages that were deleted yes because they keep sending frumby stuff he already has so I deleted so he doesn't get pissed it's happened 3 times now' and 'He got pissed twice about them sending Hayley content (old content) which he bought a long time ago… so I know what he has bought so I delete the old content and then I have to message him saying I'll make up for it'. A client who stops complaining and starts quietly cleaning up after you is the strongest churn signal this account has produced in four months, and it surfaced only because ALTR's monitoring flagged HER deletions as suspicious. Fred's reply was 'Amazing thanks for the information I'll clarify with the team!' - the same sentence he has now given twelve times since Jun 12. Against that, this was genuinely Fred's best week on the account. He posted 21 messages, needed ZERO @fspitfire escalations from Mayson for the first window since July, routed a $2,800 custom to her for approval before quoting it (the Aug 31 rule now holds 25 days), caught her phone number exposed on her Instagram story ('did you mean to post your number on your story team just wanted to check'), and refused a fan who was fronting a fake $3,000 offer to extract free content. The $2,800 video-call custom grew to $3,000 across the day - she accepted both times inside 90 seconds ('Let's fuckong do this') - and then collapsed at 17:21 when the fan deleted his account. Zero revenue, but the handling was right. THE MONEY WENT RIGHT AND NOBODY NOTICED. Three invoices in a row have gone unconfirmed, the $192 ledger gap is 31 days old, and there is now a fresh uncredited overpayment on top. WHAT WENT DARK: Stephski, Michelle, Mayson, Vivek and the owner sent NOTHING all week. Michelle's DMCA breakdown last landed Sep 8 - 17 days, a second consecutive miss, and the deliverable she never had to chase is now definitively broken. TikTok is 38 days dead across four windows. The Instagram Reels Drive is 103 days empty and on Sep 23 Mica became the THIRD person to chase her for uploads, to which she replied 'This is reels right?' - proving the written account map recommended in the last two reports still has not been sent and she still cannot tell ALTR's Drives apart.
